overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the deliberation and notice-specificity allegations, declined to review the member-encouragement allegation, and issued guidance on notice topics and posting times without ordering any remedy.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the chair directly elicited a board member's comments at an October 14 meeting, so the board deliberated outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The evidence is insufficient to overcome the Board's denial of deliberation outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Alleged the board discussed a recording of a prior meeting that was not listed with sufficient specificity on the October 14 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it discussed the recording, even though it was not listed as a topic of discussion.

allegations.summary: Alleged a board member encouraged members of the public to file Open Meeting Law complaints against the complainant, which the AG declined to review.
allegations.key_passage: An individual cannot be found in violation of the Open Meeting Law, except in their capacity as a public body member.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
